description: Thermische Energie Afvalwater (TEA - potentie) Effluent-leidingen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. The low TEA potential shows the potential for residual heat from Effluent pipes from WWTPs in the Netherlands. Water boards and some municipalities provided the data for calculating the TEA potential. See also for more information. How much heat we can extract from the effluent water depends on the temperature of the water. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Thermal Energy Wastewater (TEA - potency) Effluent pipes" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Thermische Energie Afvalwater, TEA-potentie, Effluent. The listing shows 2024-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
